literal.prompt: Какая крупная мышца под лёгкими особенно важна для дыхания?

literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 22.3 L58-L60 says breathing depends on contraction/relaxation of the diaphragm and thoracic muscles; L69-L75 identifies the diaphragm as a normal-inspiration muscle and says its contraction moves inferiorly, enlarging the thoracic cavity. OpenStax Ch.11 key terms L141-L142 confirms the diaphragm is a skeletal muscle separating thoracic and abdominal cavities. The other three options are muscles, but their verified actions in the sources are forearm, calf/foot, and jaw functions; none is the muscle especially important for normal breathing. This makes the key unique.

literalGroups.literal: Диафрагма отделяет грудную полость от брюшной и играет главную роль во вдохе. При сокращении она опускается и увеличивает объём грудной клетки.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax Ch.11 key terms L141-L142 supports the cavity-separation statement. OpenStax 22.3 L58-L60 and L69-L75 directly support the diaphragm’s role in inspiration and the mechanics: contraction moves it downward, expands the thoracic cavity, and supports airflow into the lungs.

literalGroups.literal: Диафрагма отделяет грудную полость от брюшной и играет главную роль во вдохе.
literalGroups.primaryGround: This is a true, useful anatomical fact about the correct option and is additional to the prompt and the key alone: the prompt identifies a muscle under the lungs and the key names the diaphragm, while the note adds that it separates the thoracic and abdominal cavities. The same fact may also appear in the explanation. OpenStax Ch.11 key terms L141-L142 directly supports it.

literalGroups.literal: Двуглавая мышца плеча сгибает предплечье и супинирует его.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note gives a concrete fact about the biceps brachii distractor. OpenStax Ch.11 key terms L88-L89 states that it flexes the forearm and assists in supination.

literalGroups.literal: Икроножная мышца сгибает стопу и участвует в сгибании колена.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note gives concrete actions of the gastrocnemius distractor. OpenStax 11.6 L68 says it lowers the sole of the foot and assists in moving the lower leg back toward the buttocks; L74 identifies it as the most superficial visible calf muscle. These descriptions support plantar flexion and assistance with knee flexion.

The note gives a concrete fact about the masseter distractor. OpenStax 11.3 L64 says it is the main chewing muscle because it elevates the mandible to close the mouth; L70 confirms the same movement in the lower-jaw muscle table.
